verdict.rationale: angular-docs-1 claims 'fine-grained reactivity based on Angular Signals' for fast state updates, implying compiler-optimized, non-virtual-DOM-diffing updates consistent with Angular's known incremental DOM/AOT compilation approach, and angular-comm-2 notes AOT-compilation and good performance in production use. However, no evidence explicitly details the compiler/change-detection mechanism or contrasts it with virtual DOM diffing, and no independent technical deep-dive or benchmark corroborates the claim beyond marketing copy and anecdotal community performance notes (some of which cite performance problems with large bindings). Missing for 10: detailed technical documentation of the compiler/rendering pipeline, independent benchmarks or technical analysis confirming no virtual-DOM diffing step, and resolution of community-reported performance issues with large datasets.
